steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Attend sessions from your Knoxville location at times that fit your schedule. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world scenarios relevant to project leaders across energy, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35-hour course, submit your formal PMI application and required documentation through PMI's online portal. Pay the examination fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance to ensure your application is complete and submitted correctly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence before test day. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to you. Our support continues through your final review.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or continued education. Renew your credential by submitting your PDUs and renewal fee to PMI before expiration.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
